name: Himitsu no A
source:
Sasaki, a handsome and affable doctor, had been hiding the fact that he lacked emotional depth. One night, in search of a sense of accomplishment, he crossed a line that no human should cross. The plan seemed to be going smoothly, but even those closest to Sasaki harbored secrets he knew nothing about.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4710720/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
佐佐木是一位英俊而和蔼可亲的医生，他一直隐藏着自己缺乏情感深度的事实。一天晚上，为了寻求成就感，他跨越了一条人类不应该跨越的界限。计划看似进展顺利，但即便是佐佐木最亲近的人也隐藏着他一无所知的秘密。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4710720/]Steam[/url]]
